## HX Centrifugal Pump Series - Technical Specification

Document HX-TS-004 rev. C. Issued by Halvorsen Industrial Systems Product Engineering. This specification lists the rated performance of every model in the HX series. Values apply at 50 Hz and 20 degC water.

## 2. HX-110 Centrifugal Pump

The HX-110 is recommended for chemical dosing applications. It uses a closed impeller and a mechanical shaft seal as standard.

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum flow rate | 1865 L/min |
| Maximum head | 74 m |
| Motor power | 14.1 kW |
| Impeller diameter | 272 mm |
| Dry weight | 1110 kg |
| Inlet connection | DN150 |
| Maximum fluid temperature | 120 degC |
| Motor enclosure rating | IP65 |
